Batman is one of the most intelligent beings in the DC Universe and is the second most intelligent human alive, only behind Lex Luthor. Batman is a master of a wide variety of fields of science, ranging from engineering, biology, physics, chemistry, and computer science, as demonstrated when he designed the Hall of Justice, which can transform into a mobile flying fortress, built an absolute zero prison, quickly came up with a serum that protected him and Selina from Poison Ivy's planetary pheromones, shut down a high-tech network with a device no more advanced than an ordinary cell phone, reverse-engineered Green Lantern communication and translation, hacked Apokolyptian computers and alien computers using unknown languages, developed a fully sapient Alfred AI, and a machine that grows perfect clones of himself complete with memories, experiences, training, and intelligence. He has built many different Batsuits that are highly versatile, with some of them even capable of singlehandedly fighting off the entire Justice League. Batman has also invented a wide variety of equipment, such as temporal grenades that affect time, a 10'th Metal bullet containing a miniature omniversal wormhole capable of transporting objects outside the Source Wall, and the Son Box, a device capable of reading the hearts of people, as well as building the Final Batsuit around it. Repeatedly creates perfect counters and contingencies which he flawlessly incorporates into his equipment and suits. The World Forger considers Batman one of the greatest strategic minds in existence. Is the greatest Detective and is one of the most skilled martial artists in history, with very few individuals being able to match him in a fight, and despite being powerless and alone, easily outwitted and defeated AMAZO by teleporting him away. | Nigh-Omniscient. With the Mobius Chair, Batman knows everything except who the Anti-Monitor is.

* Kyptonite (Despite being supposedly weak to it, can still survive being exposed to it for days.) * Intangibility (The Flash failed to vibrate through Superman's molecules because of their density.) * Electricity Manipulation (Unphased by several lightning bolts) * Fire Manipulation (Unphased by Rocket Fire) * Magma Manipulation (Unphased by red-hot Lava) * Mind Control (Can use "Mental-Bolts" to fight off the immortal brothers gaining control of his mind)

Extraversal (Endured the destruction of Space and Time and punched through the concept of his own death that caused it. A clash with another Superman caused Space and Time to shatter. Broke the Primordial Void to save Lois Lane. For reference, the void is the foundation of dreams, which itself is beyond space, time and dimensions. Ascended into the Dreaming, which is also beyond Space, Time and Dimensions. Could survive various forces of the Cosmology, such as speed and gods, and repel it with his heat vision. His fight with Rogol is said to cause the Phantom Zone to tremble from this fight, and Superman has said he could destroy said realm if he puts his mind to it. Broke a hole in the source wall, which is several layers above the Godsphere. Destroyed the World Forger's Multiverse, likely consisting of up to the 5th dimension, considering a corrupted Myxy and how he's a sixth dimensional entity, with one punch. The 5th Dimension itself is an infinite layer above the Godsphere, and the 6th dimension is an infinite layer above that. This was during a dip in 6th dimensional suns however, so it's unknown whether he can access this normally. Knocked out Auter.io and Barbatos with one punch, both of which being able to create and destroy stories. These would be inconsistent with his encounter with Mandrakk however, who could cause similar damage, yet Superman needed the Cosmic Armor to match. States that his mind and body are stronger than they've ever been, potentially including his amp from the 6th dimension, however it's unknown whether or not this is accurate, as the other statements he brings up in this moment are already comparable to his older self. Most of these feats affect areas far, far above the infinite dimenisons in DC.)

Extraversal (Survived being within the Void from Lois Lane's call for help. Could survive various forces of the Cosmology, such as speed and gods, and repel it with his heat vision. Endured the destruction of the Source Wall)

Immeasurable (Shattered Space, Time and the bounds of Infinity, escaping to another Universe, just trying to find Supergirl. Flew to a dead Universe. For reference, a DC Universe is infinite in size, so he likely broke the bounds of it again to get here. Can travel through time by moving fast enough. Escaped the Source, despite it having no direction or end. Perceived drifting through no time, or perhaps all of time, one point in time where it merged into said point. It's possible this doesn't scale to his flight speed and possibly just reactions though, assuming it isn't hyperbole. Potentially escaped a prison of Hypertime, which seems to be above Limbo. We only see his cape however, so it's a bit vague to consider. Said himself that he can cross distances that cease to be distance.) Irrelevant

Holds back very often in fights. NOTE: While technically Superman, at least during Post-Crisis and Post-Flashpoint, has shown to struggle with several feats around Planetary or Solar System Level, this is largely due to him unintentionally holding back, rather than actively showing his true strength. NOTE 2: While the three different eras of Superman are shown to have variable stats and abilities, they have also shown to fight on par with each other and comparable entities, meaning at least physically, they should scale to one another, hence why only Rebirth Superman is considered to determine their primary stats.

These are powers or abilities that are commonly displayed amongst members of the Green Lantern Corps in order for them to combat their enemies effectively, though do keep in mind not every member shares the same hax these are just the ones that are inherent byproducts of being a member of the Green Lantern Corps...Willpower Manipulation, Emotional Manipulation, Energy Manipulation via Emotional Energy Manipulation (Members of the Green Lantern Corps harness the power of willpower from the Emotional Energy Spectrum in order to fuel their ringsGreen Lantern: Rebirth #3 (February, 2005), it's also stated hereGreen Lantern Vol 5 #21 (August, 2013)), Indomitable Will, Flight, Creation (By using their imaginations members of the Green Lantern Corps can create constructs using their rings, Two-Six states this to be an akin to an equation with an infinite amount of possible outcomes), Telepathy (Members of The Green Lantern Corps can communicate with other members via telepathic sub-channels),

(Team Wide) Universal+ Destructive Capacity via Green Lantern Ring (Any Lantern whom uses a power ring is continuously draining the finite emotional spectrum of their universe which upon emptying ultimately results in the complete destruction of the universe itself, this is stated on multiple occasions) ==Standard Member Paraphernalia== Depending on the skill and willpower of the wearer, it can do almost anything. The first Green Lantern Ring on Earth in modern times was crafted and worn by Alan Scott and powered by the mystical Starheart. His proved to be the exception, the by-product of the efforts of the Guardians of the Universe to contain the magic of the universe. The Guardians also created the more widespread version, powered by individual Green Lantern Power Batteries through a connection to the Central Power Battery on Oa. With the exception of the ring worn by Alan Scott, the current rings are based on the one given to Kyle Rayner when he was the only Green Lantern in existence. All power rings need periodic recharging. The process is not instantaneous so many Green Lanterns recite an oath while the ring charges. The oath is not required to charge the ring, but is recited to reaffirm the person's commitment to the Green Lantern Corps, and to measure the time it takes the ring to charge. While many Green Lanterns create their own oath, the majority use the Corps' official oath as a sign of respect. In the interests of political correctness on the part of DC (or, in context, Hal Jordan), the word "blackest" was replaced by "darkest"; this practice has been abandoned with the reinstating of the Green Lantern Corps due in part to the significance of the Blackest Night comic event. Particularily alien Green Lanterns may have modified oaths. For example, Rot Lop Fan, a Green Lantern from a starless sector, replaces light with sound in his oath. The Central Power Battery is the reservoir of power for the emotional spectrum of willpower, and channels the energy used to empower the Green Lantern Corps. All of the green energy housed within a Green Lantern ring comes from a smaller battery, which in turn, functions as a conduit to the Central Power Battery on Oa. It was built billions of years ago, when the highly evolved Maltusians (now known as the Guardians of the Universe) united their powerful minds to create a green crystal - green because it was a mixture of their blue mental energy and a yellow impurity "necessary to fix its form." They grew the crystal and carved it into the shape of a giant battery, and from the same crystal carved smaller batteries and power rings. The Central Power Battery has been destroyed and rebuilt several times. It was first destroyed several years ago by the forces of Krona. Unfortunately, the battery exploded during an assemblage of all 3,600 members of the Green Lantern Corps, several of whom were killed instantly. The surviving members struggled valiantly to put out the rampaging inferno of green energy that swept across the Oan Citadel. The next cataclysmic event occurred after Sinestro's execution, which resulted in the renegade being imprisoned inside the battery. The energy of the Green Lanterns' power source started to drain their rings, stripping most of them of their power. In the end, it took the combined efforts of Hal Jordan and Appa Ali Apsa to stop the battery from exploding and creating a black hole. However, the damage caused to the battery rendered the Green Lantern Corps almost useless, with only a few Green Lanterns with active power rings scattered throughout the universe.

*Cannot harm anything that is yellow. *Rings only hold a limited energy and must be recharged with a power source on a regular basis. *If the user is filled with dread, they will be unable to use the ring and become vulnerable to the hue yellow. *If Green Lantern loses focus or concentration (for example, due to illusions), his strength weakens. (Basically don't edit my page without my consent) ==Explanations & Related Blog Posts== *Emotional Energy Spectrum: Green occupies the central position in the spectrum and symbolizes the emotion of willpower. It holds the distinction of exerting the least influence on its wielder and can only be mastered by individuals with an indomitable will capable of overcoming great fear. The embodiment of this emotion is Ion. The Maltusians initially harnessed this energy, which later passed on to the Oans, male Maltusians who aspired to establish order in the universe. After the Controllers departed, those remaining on Oa evolved into the Guardians of the Universe. These are powers or abilities that are commonly displayed amongst members of the Green Lantern Corps in order for them to combat their enemies effectively, though do keep in mind not every member shares the same hax these are just the ones that are inherent byproducts of being a member of the Green Lantern Corps...Willpower Manipulation, Emotional Manipulation, Energy Manipulation via Emotional Energy Manipulation (Members of the Green Lantern Corps harness the power of willpower from the Emotional Energy Spectrum in order to fuel their ringsGreen Lantern: Rebirth #3 (February, 2005), it's also stated hereGreen Lantern Vol 5 #21 (August, 2013)), Indomitable Will, Flight, Creation (By using their imaginations members of the Green Lantern Corps can create constructs using their rings, Two-Six states this to be an akin to an equation with an infinite amount of possible outcomes), Telepathy (Members of The Green Lantern Corps can communicate with other members via telepathic sub-channels),

(Team Wide) Universal+ Destructive Capacity via Green Lantern Ring (Any Lantern whom uses a power ring is continuously draining the finite emotional spectrum of their universe which upon emptying ultimately results in the complete destruction of the universe itself, this is stated on multiple occasions) ==Standard Member Paraphernalia== Depending on the skill and willpower of the wearer, it can do almost anything. The first Green Lantern Ring on Earth in modern times was crafted and worn by Alan Scott and powered by the mystical Starheart. His proved to be the exception, the by-product of the efforts of the Guardians of the Universe to contain the magic of the universe. The Guardians also created the more widespread version, powered by individual Green Lantern Power Batteries through a connection to the Central Power Battery on Oa. With the exception of the ring worn by Alan Scott, the current rings are based on the one given to Kyle Rayner when he was the only Green Lantern in existence. All power rings need periodic recharging. The process is not instantaneous so many Green Lanterns recite an oath while the ring charges. The oath is not required to charge the ring, but is recited to reaffirm the person's commitment to the Green Lantern Corps, and to measure the time it takes the ring to charge. While many Green Lanterns create their own oath, the majority use the Corps' official oath as a sign of respect. In the interests of political correctness on the part of DC (or, in context, Hal Jordan), the word "blackest" was replaced by "darkest"; this practice has been abandoned with the reinstating of the Green Lantern Corps due in part to the significance of the Blackest Night comic event. Particularily alien Green Lanterns may have modified oaths. For example, Rot Lop Fan, a Green Lantern from a starless sector, replaces light with sound in his oath. The Central Power Battery is the reservoir of power for the emotional spectrum of willpower, and channels the energy used to empower the Green Lantern Corps. All of the green energy housed within a Green Lantern ring comes from a smaller battery, which in turn, functions as a conduit to the Central Power Battery on Oa. It was built billions of years ago, when the highly evolved Maltusians (now known as the Guardians of the Universe) united their powerful minds to create a green crystal - green because it was a mixture of their blue mental energy and a yellow impurity "necessary to fix its form." They grew the crystal and carved it into the shape of a giant battery, and from the same crystal carved smaller batteries and power rings. The Central Power Battery has been destroyed and rebuilt several times. It was first destroyed several years ago by the forces of Krona. Unfortunately, the battery exploded during an assemblage of all 3,600 members of the Green Lantern Corps, several of whom were killed instantly. The surviving members struggled valiantly to put out the rampaging inferno of green energy that swept across the Oan Citadel. The next cataclysmic event occurred after Sinestro's execution, which resulted in the renegade being imprisoned inside the battery. The energy of the Green Lanterns' power source started to drain their rings, stripping most of them of their power. In the end, it took the combined efforts of Hal Jordan and Appa Ali Apsa to stop the battery from exploding and creating a black hole. However, the damage caused to the battery rendered the Green Lantern Corps almost useless, with only a few Green Lanterns with active power rings scattered throughout the universe.

*Cannot harm anything that is yellow. *Rings only hold a limited energy and must be recharged with a power source on a regular basis. *If the user is filled with dread, they will be unable to use the ring and become vulnerable to the hue yellow. *If Green Lantern loses focus or concentration (for example, due to illusions), his strength weakens. It holds the distinction of exerting the least influence on its wielder and can only be mastered by individuals with an indomitable will capable of overcoming great fear. The embodiment of this emotion is Ion. The Maltusians initially harnessed this energy, which later passed on to the Oans, male Maltusians who aspired to establish order in the universe. After the Controllers departed, those remaining on Oa evolved into the Guardians of the Universe. *Superhuman Physical Characteristics (See Speed and Durability) *Indomitable Will (Served as a Green Lantern) *Empowerment (Empowered by his Yellow Power ring) *Flight (Can fly at tremendous speeds, even through space) *Weapon Mastery (with his ring) *Energy Projection (Can fire beams and blasts of Yellow Energy) *Psuedo-Telekinesis (Can lift and move things with his constructs) *Creation/Weapon Creation (Has created various constructs, such as a mace, a huge sword, axes, a buzzsaw, a giant hammer, a pitchfork, a dragon, a drill, a huge alien beast, et cetera) *Forcefield Creation (Can create barriers to block attacks) *Paralysis Inducement (Created restraint constructs to contain Superman) *Explosion Manipulation (Created a construct that blew up) *Illusion Creation (Disguised himself as John Stewart) *Light Manipulation (Used his ring as an X-Ray) *Electricity Manipulation (Gave microchips an electric charge) *BFR (Blasted Kyle Rayner from a mountain range to the Ferris Airfield) *Resistance to Electricity Manipulation (Blocked a blast from Static) *Resistance to Radiation Manipulation (Made Luthor's ship radiation-proof) *Resistance to Cosmic Radiations (Flew through space, as seen in “In Brightest Day”) - as well as possibly many more abilities depending on whether or not his ring is identical in function to a normal Green Lantern Ring

Brown Dwarf Level (Scaling to 1.002 Quettatons - Demonstrably evenly matched with Green Lantern, even knocking him out with a continuous blast (despite GL's energy barrier being active) and swatting him away with a mace construct. Stated to be able to destroy planets. Kept Superman off his feet with his attacks, though notably never doing any meaningful damage and being decidedly outperformed in their second encounter, when he didn't have the advantage of taking him off guard. Temporarily KO’d Hawkgirl in one attack. Pulverized a huge wall of ice with one blow - while this episode implies Sinestro couldn't have done this to a stone wall, the preponderance of higher scaling he has make this one of the DCAU's many easy-to-dismiss low ends, especially considering the fact that Sinestro performs a feat roughly equivalent to destroying a stone wall just moments later without breaking a sweat)

Relativistic+ reactions and combat speed (Scaling to 0.53c - Can fight close battles with (and is clearly about as fast as) the likes of Green Lantern, Kyle Rayner (both of which can react to and block his light-speed beams), and Static. Has a feat of dodging a Lantern Beam, and is comparable to many others who have similar feats - all these feats compiled here. Reacted to and blocked electricity from Static at point-blank - Static's electricity blasts being this fast), with Speed of Light attack speed with Lantern Beams (Explained here), Massively FTL+ flight speed in space (Considering his ring (in the comics the DCAU is taking from) is intended to be a replica of the Green Lantern ring without the need to charge it, his flight speed shouldn’t be any slower than he was as a prominent Green Lantern, wherein he was presumably comparable in flight speed to the likes of Jessica Cruz, Salakk, and Katma Tui), and Massively Hypersonic flight speed in an atmosphere (Upscales from Mach 106 - Pursued and kept pace with Kyle Rayner while the latter was desperately trying to fly away from him, and as such logically would have been using his full flight speed)

Brown Dwarf Level physically (Scaling to 1.002 Quettatons - Similar to Green Lantern, surrounds himself in a skintight barrier of Lantern Energy), Small Star Level with constructs (Scaling to 8.018 Quettatons - His other constructs should be comparable to Green Lantern’s, and have withstood punches from Wonder Woman, temporarily restrained Superman, blocked a blast from a furious Static, among other feats)

None notable. Ergo, I only consider those three comics canon. Category:Goulden1998 Category:Tier 5

These are powers or abilities that are commonly displayed amongst members of the Green Lantern Corps in order for them to combat their enemies effectively, though do keep in mind not every member shares the same hax these are just the ones that are inherent byproducts of being a member of the Green Lantern Corps...Willpower Manipulation, Emotional Manipulation, Energy Manipulation via Emotional Energy Manipulation (Members of the Green Lantern Corps harness the power of willpower from the Emotional Energy Spectrum in order to fuel their ringsGreen Lantern: Rebirth #3 (February, 2005), it's also stated hereGreen Lantern Vol 5 #21 (August, 2013)), Indomitable Will, Flight, Creation (By using their imaginations members of the Green Lantern Corps can create constructs using their rings, Two-Six states this to be an akin to an equation with an infinite amount of possible outcomes), Telepathy (Members of The Green Lantern Corps can communicate with other members via telepathic sub-channels),

(Team Wide) Universal+ Destructive Capacity via Green Lantern Ring (Any Lantern whom uses a power ring is continuously draining the finite emotional spectrum of their universe which upon emptying ultimately results in the complete destruction of the universe itself, this is stated on multiple occasions) ==Standard Member Paraphernalia== Depending on the skill and willpower of the wearer, it can do almost anything. The first Green Lantern Ring on Earth in modern times was crafted and worn by Alan Scott and powered by the mystical Starheart. His proved to be the exception, the by-product of the efforts of the Guardians of the Universe to contain the magic of the universe. The Guardians also created the more widespread version, powered by individual Green Lantern Power Batteries through a connection to the Central Power Battery on Oa. With the exception of the ring worn by Alan Scott, the current rings are based on the one given to Kyle Rayner when he was the only Green Lantern in existence. All power rings need periodic recharging. The process is not instantaneous so many Green Lanterns recite an oath while the ring charges. The oath is not required to charge the ring, but is recited to reaffirm the person's commitment to the Green Lantern Corps, and to measure the time it takes the ring to charge. While many Green Lanterns create their own oath, the majority use the Corps' official oath as a sign of respect. In the interests of political correctness on the part of DC (or, in context, Hal Jordan), the word "blackest" was replaced by "darkest"; this practice has been abandoned with the reinstating of the Green Lantern Corps due in part to the significance of the Blackest Night comic event. Particularily alien Green Lanterns may have modified oaths. For example, Rot Lop Fan, a Green Lantern from a starless sector, replaces light with sound in his oath. The Central Power Battery is the reservoir of power for the emotional spectrum of willpower, and channels the energy used to empower the Green Lantern Corps. All of the green energy housed within a Green Lantern ring comes from a smaller battery, which in turn, functions as a conduit to the Central Power Battery on Oa. It was built billions of years ago, when the highly evolved Maltusians (now known as the Guardians of the Universe) united their powerful minds to create a green crystal - green because it was a mixture of their blue mental energy and a yellow impurity "necessary to fix its form." They grew the crystal and carved it into the shape of a giant battery, and from the same crystal carved smaller batteries and power rings. The Central Power Battery has been destroyed and rebuilt several times. It was first destroyed several years ago by the forces of Krona. Unfortunately, the battery exploded during an assemblage of all 3,600 members of the Green Lantern Corps, several of whom were killed instantly. The surviving members struggled valiantly to put out the rampaging inferno of green energy that swept across the Oan Citadel. The next cataclysmic event occurred after Sinestro's execution, which resulted in the renegade being imprisoned inside the battery. The energy of the Green Lanterns' power source started to drain their rings, stripping most of them of their power. In the end, it took the combined efforts of Hal Jordan and Appa Ali Apsa to stop the battery from exploding and creating a black hole. However, the damage caused to the battery rendered the Green Lantern Corps almost useless, with only a few Green Lanterns with active power rings scattered throughout the universe.

*Cannot harm anything that is yellow. *Rings only hold a limited energy and must be recharged with a power source on a regular basis. *If the user is filled with dread, they will be unable to use the ring and become vulnerable to the hue yellow. *If Green Lantern loses focus or concentration (for example, due to illusions), his strength weakens. Unauthorized editing may compromise the accuracy, integrity, and reliability of the content. If you have suggestions or concerns regarding the information presented herein, please contact the designated administrator for assistance. (Basically don't edit my page without my consent) ==Explanations & Related Blog Posts== *Emotional Energy Spectrum: Green occupies the central position in the spectrum and symbolizes the emotion of willpower. It holds the distinction of exerting the least influence on its wielder and can only be mastered by individuals with an indomitable will capable of overcoming great fear. The embodiment of this emotion is Ion. The Maltusians initially harnessed this energy, which later passed on to the Oans, male Maltusians who aspired to establish order in the universe. After the Controllers departed, those remaining on Oa evolved into the Guardians of the Universe. They utilized the green light as the power source for the Green Lantern Corps, an organization committed to combating evil wherever and whenever it emerged to threaten the universe. ==Gallery== *310 Appearances of Green Lantern Corps (Prime Earth) *75 Images that include Green Lantern Corps (Prime Earth) *Organization Gallery: Green Lantern Corps (Prime Earth) ==Others== Notable Victories: Notable Losses: Inconclusive Matches: ==References== ==Categories

These are powers or abilities that are commonly displayed amongst members of the Green Lantern Corps in order for them to combat their enemies effectively, though do keep in mind not every member shares the same hax these are just the ones that are inherent byproducts of being a member of the Green Lantern Corps...Willpower Manipulation, Emotional Manipulation, Energy Manipulation via Emotional Energy Manipulation (Members of the Green Lantern Corps harness the power of willpower from the Emotional Energy Spectrum in order to fuel their ringsGreen Lantern: Rebirth #3 (February, 2005), it's also stated hereGreen Lantern Vol 5 #21 (August, 2013)), Indomitable Will, Flight, Creation (By using their imaginations members of the Green Lantern Corps can create constructs using their rings, Two-Six states this to be an akin to an equation with an infinite amount of possible outcomes), Telepathy (Members of The Green Lantern Corps can communicate with other members via telepathic sub-channels),

(Team Wide) Universal+ Destructive Capacity via Green Lantern Ring (Any Lantern whom uses a power ring is continuously draining the finite emotional spectrum of their universe which upon emptying ultimately results in the complete destruction of the universe itself, this is stated on multiple occasions) ==Standard Member Paraphernalia== Depending on the skill and willpower of the wearer, it can do almost anything. The first Green Lantern Ring on Earth in modern times was crafted and worn by Alan Scott and powered by the mystical Starheart. His proved to be the exception, the by-product of the efforts of the Guardians of the Universe to contain the magic of the universe. The Guardians also created the more widespread version, powered by individual Green Lantern Power Batteries through a connection to the Central Power Battery on Oa. With the exception of the ring worn by Alan Scott, the current rings are based on the one given to Kyle Rayner when he was the only Green Lantern in existence. All power rings need periodic recharging. The process is not instantaneous so many Green Lanterns recite an oath while the ring charges. The oath is not required to charge the ring, but is recited to reaffirm the person's commitment to the Green Lantern Corps, and to measure the time it takes the ring to charge. While many Green Lanterns create their own oath, the majority use the Corps' official oath as a sign of respect. In the interests of political correctness on the part of DC (or, in context, Hal Jordan), the word "blackest" was replaced by "darkest"; this practice has been abandoned with the reinstating of the Green Lantern Corps due in part to the significance of the Blackest Night comic event. Particularily alien Green Lanterns may have modified oaths. For example, Rot Lop Fan, a Green Lantern from a starless sector, replaces light with sound in his oath. The Central Power Battery is the reservoir of power for the emotional spectrum of willpower, and channels the energy used to empower the Green Lantern Corps. All of the green energy housed within a Green Lantern ring comes from a smaller battery, which in turn, functions as a conduit to the Central Power Battery on Oa. It was built billions of years ago, when the highly evolved Maltusians (now known as the Guardians of the Universe) united their powerful minds to create a green crystal - green because it was a mixture of their blue mental energy and a yellow impurity "necessary to fix its form." They grew the crystal and carved it into the shape of a giant battery, and from the same crystal carved smaller batteries and power rings. The Central Power Battery has been destroyed and rebuilt several times. It was first destroyed several years ago by the forces of Krona. Unfortunately, the battery exploded during an assemblage of all 3,600 members of the Green Lantern Corps, several of whom were killed instantly. The surviving members struggled valiantly to put out the rampaging inferno of green energy that swept across the Oan Citadel. The next cataclysmic event occurred after Sinestro's execution, which resulted in the renegade being imprisoned inside the battery. The energy of the Green Lanterns' power source started to drain their rings, stripping most of them of their power. In the end, it took the combined efforts of Hal Jordan and Appa Ali Apsa to stop the battery from exploding and creating a black hole. However, the damage caused to the battery rendered the Green Lantern Corps almost useless, with only a few Green Lanterns with active power rings scattered throughout the universe.

*Cannot harm anything that is yellow. *Rings only hold a limited energy and must be recharged with a power source on a regular basis. *If the user is filled with dread, they will be unable to use the ring and become vulnerable to the hue yellow. *If Green Lantern loses focus or concentration (for example, due to illusions), his strength weakens. (Basically don't edit my page without my consent) ==Explanations & Related Blog Posts== *Emotional Energy Spectrum: Green occupies the central position in the spectrum and symbolizes the emotion of willpower. It holds the distinction of exerting the least influence on its wielder and can only be mastered by individuals with an indomitable will capable of overcoming great fear. The embodiment of this emotion is Ion. The Maltusians initially harnessed this energy, which later passed on to the Oans, male Maltusians who aspired to establish order in the universe. After the Controllers departed, those remaining on Oa evolved into the Guardians of the Universe. They utilized the green light as the power source for the Green Lantern Corps, an organization committed to combating evil wherever and whenever it emerged to threaten the universe. ==Gallery== *310 Appearances of Green Lantern Corps (Prime Earth) *75 Images that include Green Lantern Corps (Prime Earth) *Organization Gallery: Green Lantern Corps (Prime Earth) ==Others== Notable Victories: Notable Losses: Inconclusive Matches: ==References== ==Categories

Varies from Below Average to Gifted or Genius. Generally at his lowest showings, Grundy possesses a brutish attitude and a monosyllabic speech which renders him incapable of saying anything other than the nursery rhyme from which he draws his name, but at his highest showings, he has occasional moments of savage cunning where he is capable of masterminding complex criminal plots.

Solomon Grundy's resurrection is unusual in its nature. When he is slain, he is reconstructed and reborn from Slaughter Swamp, but never perfectly, or even the same way twice. The amount of intellect and memory Grundy retains from his time as Cyrus Gold varies significantly - he is typically dimwitted and thuggish, but on other occasions, he is barely capable of speech, and at points, he has even been a highly intelligent and effective crime lord. His level of power also varies from resurrection to resurrection, with him at times being battled relatively evenly by street-level characters, and at other times overpowering entire teams of superpowered beings. Though comic characters are normally highly variable, Grundy is one of the few who has an in-universe justification. His resurrections usually remove his memory of anything that happened prior and can result in him being reborn in a much dumber or weaker form. Though his intellect varies, his fighting style is invariably that of a brawler, relying on brute strength to overwhelm the opponent. Note: His stats vary wildly between incarnations. Solomon Grundy's resurrection is unusual in its nature. When he is slain, he is reconstructed and reborn from Slaughter Swamp, but never perfectly, or even the same way twice. The amount of intellect and memory Grundy retains from his time as Cyrus Gold varies significantly - he is typically dimwitted and thuggish, but on other occasions, he is barely capable of speech, he has even been a highly intelligent and effective crime lord. His level of power also varies from resurrection to resurrection, with him at times being battled relatively evenly by street-level characters, and at other times overpowering entire teams of superpowered beings. Though comic characters are normally highly variable, Grundy is one of the few who has an in-universe justification. His resurrections usually remove his memory of anything that happened prior and can result in him being reborn in a much dumber or weaker form. Though his intellect varies, his fighting style is invariably that of a brawler, relying on brute strength to overwhelm the opponent

* Superhuman Physical Characteristics (See Attack Potency, Speed, Lifting Strength, and Durability) * Superhuman Athleticism (Has leapt insane distances) * Magic (Is animated by both a curse placed on him right after his death and the magic of Slaughter Swamp, and thus is a being of magic) * Immortality (Type 1: Is a living dead man who cannot die from natural causes, though he could be killed by Icthultu) * Shockwave Creation (Dispersed a cloud of ash with a thunderclap) * Immunity to Soul Manipulation (Has no soul, and thus astral attacks would have absolutely no effect on him) In his resurrected forms, he wields all his prior abilities as well as: * Energy Absorption (Absorbed a small portion of AMAZO's energy into him, and passively grew stronger by absorbing AMAZO's ambient energy just by being near him) * A greater degree of Shockwave Creation (Created massive shockwaves while fighting Green Lantern)

Large Planet Level (Downscaling from 1.03 Ronnatons - Can keep JL Season 1 Superman off his feet and give him pause, though when this Superman is more prepared he's depicted as savagely pummeling Grundy into unconsciousness and is referred to as being so strong that Grundy is "no match" for him. During "The Terror Beyond," is somewhat capable of scrapping with JL Season 2 Superman, who's been restored to his proper strength level, even putting him in a hold and knocking him away with attacks - however, the fact that Superman is overtly totally unhurt by his attacks, strongly implies he's holding back out of sympathy for Grundy, refers to Pre-Resurrection Grundy as "not having a chance" against him, and during "Wake the Dead" is able to show low-end relativity to a far more powerful Grundy than was in "Terror Beyond," makes me conclude he shouldn't really scale to a full-strength Superman. Slammed Martian Manhunter back with a palm strike, knocked him off his feet by charging through stone, is thought of by Superman as "as strong" as J'onn, and knocked him out cold with a weapon strike to the head. Regarded as "tough" by Green Lantern, who at the time only knew of his pre-resurrection state. Killed Icthultu, albeit by attacking him from the inside. Referred to by promotional material as having "the muscle to crush any of our heroes" - though we know this isn't necessarily true of Superman, we have no reason to assume the statement is *entirely* invalid - ergo, this statement implies he could harm or even defeat the likes of Martian Manhunter or Wonder Woman in a bare-knuckle brawl. Ripped a tank in half. Rent a huge section of the ground by punching it. Destroyed a large truck with a ground pound. Threw rocks with enough force to destroy tanks and threw a metal dumpster with enough force to destroy a car. Smashed a desk and charged through a stone wall. Punched Superman so hard it created a large crater in stone) | Up to Large Star Level at his peak (Scaling to 1.664 Foe - Stated by Doctor Fate to be far more powerful than he had ever been while "alive." Caught Superman's punch and made him yell in pain by crushing his hand, knocked him away with a punch, and temporarily rendered him unable to fight. The Spectre, as one of the foremost cosmic beings in creation, possesses a vast amount of raw intelligence and knowledge, including encyclopedic knowledge of spells and counter-spells, demons, extradimensional realms, etc. He was even able to briefly comprehend omniscience when given a glimpse of it by the Source. However, due to his nature, he has had difficulties comprehending human nature and motivation, and his rage-fueled nature has allowed others such as Eclipso to trick him.

The Spectre can be harmed by artifacts of the Presence, such as the Spear of Destiny and Ring of Life, or by certain divinely enchanted weapons such as Pandora's knives. He can also be bound or have his power temporarily sealed by special magics wielded by extremely skilled magicians, such as Madame Xanadu. When the Spectre judges souls by entering them, he often faces more difficulty than if he had simply rendered judgment outside the victim's soul. The Spectre cannot judge souls the Presence does not allow him to. Also, Fear-Inducing Stare: The Spectre often avoids combat entirely by intimidating his victims with a special stare. The victim sees a vision of skulls across the Spectre's eyes, and they feel fear so intense they can't move. Some have even been driven insane., Judgment: The Spectre's most-often used technique involves reality warping or matter manipulation to create ironic punishments for his victims in accordance with their crimes. Oftentimes, this comes after the Spectre has entered his victim's soul and judged what he finds, although such is not always the case, the time period between the Crisis and the start of the 1992 Spectre run had the Spectre drastically weakened. The Spectre, as one of the foremost cosmic beings in creation, possesses a vast amount of raw intelligence and knowledge, including encyclopedic knowledge of spells and counter-spells, demons, extradimensional realms, etc. He was even able to briefly comprehend omniscience when given a glimpse of it by the Source. However, due to his nature, he has had difficulties comprehending human nature and motivation, and his rage-fueled nature has allowed others such as Eclipso to trick him.

The Spectre can be harmed by artifacts of the Presence, such as the Spear of Destiny and Ring of Life, or by certain divinely enchanted weapons such as Pandora's knives. He can also be bound or have his power temporarily sealed by special magics wielded by extremely skilled magicians, such as Madame Xanadu. When the Spectre judges souls by entering them, he often faces more difficulty than if he had simply rendered judgment outside the victim's soul. The Spectre cannot judge souls the Presence does not allow him to. Also, Fear-Inducing Stare: The Spectre often avoids combat entirely by intimidating his victims with a special stare. The victim sees a vision of skulls across the Spectre's eyes, and they feel fear so intense they can't move. Some have even been driven insane., Judgment: The Spectre's most-often used technique involves reality warping or matter manipulation to create ironic punishments for his victims in accordance with their crimes. Oftentimes, this comes after the Spectre has entered his victim's soul and judged what he finds, although such is not always the case, the time period between the Crisis and the start of the 1992 Spectre run had the Spectre drastically weakened. The Spectre, as one of the foremost cosmic beings in creation, possesses a vast amount of raw intelligence and knowledge, including encyclopedic knowledge of spells and counter-spells, demons, extradimensional realms, etc. He was even able to briefly comprehend omniscience when given a glimpse of it by the Source. However, due to his nature, he has had difficulties comprehending human nature and motivation, and his rage-fueled nature has allowed others such as Eclipso to trick him.

The Spectre can be harmed by artifacts of the Presence, such as the Spear of Destiny and Ring of Life, or by certain divinely enchanted weapons such as Pandora's knives. He can also be bound or have his power temporarily sealed by special magics wielded by extremely skilled magicians, such as Madame Xanadu. When the Spectre judges souls by entering them, he often faces more difficulty than if he had simply rendered judgment outside the victim's soul. The Spectre cannot judge souls the Presence does not allow him to. Also, Fear-Inducing Stare: The Spectre often avoids combat entirely by intimidating his victims with a special stare. The victim sees a vision of skulls across the Spectre's eyes, and they feel fear so intense they can't move. Some have even been driven insane., Judgment: The Spectre's most-often used technique involves reality warping or matter manipulation to create ironic punishments for his victims in accordance with their crimes. Oftentimes, this comes after the Spectre has entered his victim's soul and judged what he finds, although such is not always the case, the time period between the Crisis and the start of the 1992 Spectre run had the Spectre drastically weakened. The Spectre, as one of the foremost cosmic beings in creation, possesses a vast amount of raw intelligence and knowledge, including encyclopedic knowledge of spells and counter-spells, demons, extradimensional realms, etc. He was even able to briefly comprehend omniscience when given a glimpse of it by the Source. However, due to his nature, he has had difficulties comprehending human nature and motivation, and his rage-fueled nature has allowed others such as Eclipso to trick him.

The Spectre can be harmed by artifacts of the Presence, such as the Spear of Destiny and Ring of Life, or by certain divinely enchanted weapons such as Pandora's knives. He can also be bound or have his power temporarily sealed by special magics wielded by extremely skilled magicians, such as Madame Xanadu. When the Spectre judges souls by entering them, he often faces more difficulty than if he had simply rendered judgment outside the victim's soul. The Spectre cannot judge souls the Presence does not allow him to. Also, Fear-Inducing Stare: The Spectre often avoids combat entirely by intimidating his victims with a special stare. The victim sees a vision of skulls across the Spectre's eyes, and they feel fear so intense they can't move. Some have even been driven insane., Judgment: The Spectre's most-often used technique involves reality warping or matter manipulation to create ironic punishments for his victims in accordance with their crimes. Oftentimes, this comes after the Spectre has entered his victim's soul and judged what he finds, although such is not always the case, the time period between the Crisis and the start of the 1992 Spectre run had the Spectre drastically weakened. The Spectre, as one of the foremost cosmic beings in creation, possesses a vast amount of raw intelligence and knowledge, including encyclopedic knowledge of spells and counter-spells, demons, extradimensional realms, etc. He was even able to briefly comprehend omniscience when given a glimpse of it by the Source. However, due to his nature, he has had difficulties comprehending human nature and motivation, and his rage-fueled nature has allowed others such as Eclipso to trick him.

The Spectre can be harmed by artifacts of the Presence, such as the Spear of Destiny and Ring of Life, or by certain divinely enchanted weapons such as Pandora's knives. He can also be bound or have his power temporarily sealed by special magics wielded by extremely skilled magicians, such as Madame Xanadu. When the Spectre judges souls by entering them, he often faces more difficulty than if he had simply rendered judgment outside the victim's soul. The Spectre cannot judge souls the Presence does not allow him to. Also, Fear-Inducing Stare: The Spectre often avoids combat entirely by intimidating his victims with a special stare. The victim sees a vision of skulls across the Spectre's eyes, and they feel fear so intense they can't move. Some have even been driven insane., Judgment: The Spectre's most-often used technique involves reality warping or matter manipulation to create ironic punishments for his victims in accordance with their crimes. Oftentimes, this comes after the Spectre has entered his victim's soul and judged what he finds, although such is not always the case, the time period between the Crisis and the start of the 1992 Spectre run had the Spectre drastically weakened. The Spectre, as one of the foremost cosmic beings in creation, possesses a vast amount of raw intelligence and knowledge, including encyclopedic knowledge of spells and counter-spells, demons, extradimensional realms, etc. He was even able to briefly comprehend omniscience when given a glimpse of it by the Source. However, due to his nature, he has had difficulties comprehending human nature and motivation, and his rage-fueled nature has allowed others such as Eclipso to trick him.

The Spectre can be harmed by artifacts of the Presence, such as the Spear of Destiny and Ring of Life, or by certain divinely enchanted weapons such as Pandora's knives. He can also be bound or have his power temporarily sealed by special magics wielded by extremely skilled magicians, such as Madame Xanadu. When the Spectre judges souls by entering them, he often faces more difficulty than if he had simply rendered judgment outside the victim's soul. The Spectre cannot judge souls the Presence does not allow him to. Also, Fear-Inducing Stare: The Spectre often avoids combat entirely by intimidating his victims with a special stare. The victim sees a vision of skulls across the Spectre's eyes, and they feel fear so intense they can't move. Some have even been driven insane., Judgment: The Spectre's most-often used technique involves reality warping or matter manipulation to create ironic punishments for his victims in accordance with their crimes. Oftentimes, this comes after the Spectre has entered his victim's soul and judged what he finds, although such is not always the case, the time period between the Crisis and the start of the 1992 Spectre run had the Spectre drastically weakened. The Spectre, as one of the foremost cosmic beings in creation, possesses a vast amount of raw intelligence and knowledge, including encyclopedic knowledge of spells and counter-spells, demons, extradimensional realms, etc. He was even able to briefly comprehend omniscience when given a glimpse of it by the Source. However, due to his nature, he has had difficulties comprehending human nature and motivation, and his rage-fueled nature has allowed others such as Eclipso to trick him.

The Spectre can be harmed by artifacts of the Presence, such as the Spear of Destiny and Ring of Life, or by certain divinely enchanted weapons such as Pandora's knives. He can also be bound or have his power temporarily sealed by special magics wielded by extremely skilled magicians, such as Madame Xanadu. When the Spectre judges souls by entering them, he often faces more difficulty than if he had simply rendered judgment outside the victim's soul. The Spectre cannot judge souls the Presence does not allow him to. Also, Fear-Inducing Stare: The Spectre often avoids combat entirely by intimidating his victims with a special stare. The victim sees a vision of skulls across the Spectre's eyes, and they feel fear so intense they can't move. Some have even been driven insane., Judgment: The Spectre's most-often used technique involves reality warping or matter manipulation to create ironic punishments for his victims in accordance with their crimes. Oftentimes, this comes after the Spectre has entered his victim's soul and judged what he finds, although such is not always the case, the time period between the Crisis and the start of the 1992 Spectre run had the Spectre drastically weakened. The Spectre, as one of the foremost cosmic beings in creation, possesses a vast amount of raw intelligence and knowledge, including encyclopedic knowledge of spells and counter-spells, demons, extradimensional realms, etc. He was even able to briefly comprehend omniscience when given a glimpse of it by the Source. However, due to his nature, he has had difficulties comprehending human nature and motivation, and his rage-fueled nature has allowed others such as Eclipso to trick him.

The Spectre can be harmed by artifacts of the Presence, such as the Spear of Destiny and Ring of Life, or by certain divinely enchanted weapons such as Pandora's knives. He can also be bound or have his power temporarily sealed by special magics wielded by extremely skilled magicians, such as Madame Xanadu. When the Spectre judges souls by entering them, he often faces more difficulty than if he had simply rendered judgment outside the victim's soul. The Spectre cannot judge souls the Presence does not allow him to. Also, Fear-Inducing Stare: The Spectre often avoids combat entirely by intimidating his victims with a special stare. The victim sees a vision of skulls across the Spectre's eyes, and they feel fear so intense they can't move. Some have even been driven insane., Judgment: The Spectre's most-often used technique involves reality warping or matter manipulation to create ironic punishments for his victims in accordance with their crimes. Oftentimes, this comes after the Spectre has entered his victim's soul and judged what he finds, although such is not always the case, the time period between the Crisis and the start of the 1992 Spectre run had the Spectre drastically weakened. At least 3-A, likely Low 2-C.

Superhuman Physical Characteristics, Self-Sustenance (Type 1, does not need oxygen to breath and can survive in space), Flight, Absorption (Her species naturally absorbs solar energy. She can absorb nearby energy and enemy attacks), Energy Projection (Can fire blasts of stellar energy or omnidirectional energy pulses called novas), Danmaku (Can fire many starbolts at once), Heat Manipulation (Touching her skin caused Red Hood's gun to melt), Fire Manipulation (Can project fire even reaching interplanetary distances), Light Manipulation (can create a blinding flash of light), Martial Arts (Trained by the warlords of Okaara, beat Donna Troy 4 times in a row, rivals Wonder Woman and equaled her in melee, Wonder Woman regularly fighting and equaling Ares, the embodiment of war with the martial arts, tactical wisdom, strategy and tactics of every battle in history), Acupuncture (Even without her powers can knock people unconscious via nerve strikes), Healing (proficient in healing, can cauterize a wound) Enhanced Senses (can see through cloaking devices, can hear things while unconscious, can feel herself being stimulated on a cellular level), Linguistic Assimilation (Can absorb languages via touch, mostly by kissing), Enhanced Beauty (Causes even animals and rock based lifeforms to be attracted to her), Non-Physical Interaction (Affected Raven's Soul-Self and was stated to be able to stop Raven despite her intangibility). Resistance to Acupuncture (human pressure points don't work on her), Fire Manipulation (withstood the burning solar attack of the sun titaness Theia), Ice Manipulation (resisted being frozen), Knockout gases (knockout gases didn't work on Starfire), Memory Manipulation (Starfire's memories are particularly hard to read), Fear Manipulation (was immune to Phobia's fear manipulation), Emotional Manipulation (an apathy fiend didn't effect Starfire), Energy Manipulation and Power Nullification (Energy Dampening and Power Nullification technology doesn't work on her 1 2 3), Death Manipulation (Survived a hit from the Horsemen of Death), Time Manipulation and Reality-Warping (Survived near the closure of the cosmic storm which sent out a reality-warping wave that massively warped time)

At least High Universe level (can harm beings comparable to her, slew a titan on the level of titans and olympians that were going to shake the cosmos, the DC Universe consistently stated to be infinite. Was stated to be the only titan able to stop Demon Raven and the strongest titan by Beast Boy with Raven having the capacity to turn the heavens to ashes and having the power within herself to destroy a universe. Crashed through Trigon's skeleton, with the same Trigon being a multiversal entity comparable to the Spectre and even at 1/10th his power was able to destroy a universe), likely Universe level+ (Wields power that defies measure and imagination, Superior to Connor Kent and Cassie Sandsmark, Connor Kent can break Lex Luthor's warsuit, broke free from Pre-Crisis Supergirl and Powergirl 1 2, takes numerous blows from Silver Age Superboy, survived a blow from Kingdom Come Superman, fought against a clone of Doomsday, Orion, and Superboy Prime, Cassie Sandsmark can destroy Superman androids, nearly as strong as Superman himself, fought Devastation who is equal to Wonder Woman and withstands attacks from Lex Luthor's warsuit. Has harmed Firestorm and Etrigan with her strikes. Starfire can overpower Donna Troy and was able to knock back and stated to be able to beat her titaness form Troia, Donna Troy able to get the upper hand on Superwoman, evil universe counterpart to Wonder Woman and survive an explosion that hurt Superboy Prime. Starfire fought Post-Crisis Wonder Woman herself and hurt Silver Age Wonder Woman with a starbolt. Starfire also hurt Envy with Wonder Woman's powers. Harmed Sinestro with her starbolt and has harmed Green Lantern level entities on numerous occasions), Higher with nova (amplifies her power drastically briefly)

Immeasurable, likely Irrelevant (Fought Wonder Woman in melee and caught up to Wonder Woman's Invisible Jet which should be comparable to Wonder Woman. Surprised Envy with Wonder Woman's powers with an attack. Superior to Connor Kent who has reacted to Kingdom Come Flash. Tagged Jesse Quick, one of the fastest people alive relative to Superman)

At least High Universe level (Survived a cosmic storm that was moving the universe off-balance and threatening the universe, can survive attacks from Titans 1 2 3 that were going to shake the cosmos in their battle the olympians), likely Universal+ (The cosmic storm was created an unprecedented warping in the spacetime continuum. Survived a blast from Orion, survived the attack of Silver Swan which could harm Wonder Woman, survived a blow from Envy with Wonder Woman's powers and from the demonic Shazam, Sabbac. Protected Jessica Cruz from radiation that was threatening her.)

Impulsive and overly emotional. Weakens without sunlight. Holds back and is sometimes naive and overly trusting (though this is somewhat inconsistent and depending on writing). Notable Attacks/Techniques: * Starbolt: Starfire can fire bolts of stellar energy out of her hands. She is highly skilled and accurate with these * Nova: Starfire releases an omnidirectional energy pulse massively stronger then her normal starbolt, though this is draining to use. Note: Convergence and Rebirth have made all eras of DC Comics history canon. This has been confirmed by Word of God numerous times and has been shown numerous times in-universe with characters remembering events as far back as the Pre-Crisis era. Superhuman Physical Characteristics, Self-Sustenance (Type 1, does not need oxygen to breath and can survive in space), Flight, Absorption (Her species naturally absorbs solar energy. She can absorb nearby energy and enemy attacks), Energy Projection (Can fire blasts of stellar energy or omnidirectional energy pulses called novas), Danmaku (Can fire many starbolts at once), Heat Manipulation (Touching her skin caused Red Hood's gun to melt), Fire Manipulation (Can project fire even reaching interplanetary distances), Light Manipulation (can create a blinding flash of light), Martial Arts (Trained by the warlords of Okaara, beat Donna Troy 4 times in a row, rivals Wonder Woman and equaled her in melee, Wonder Woman regularly fighting and equaling Ares, the embodiment of war with the martial arts, tactical wisdom, strategy and tactics of every battle in history), Acupuncture (Even without her powers can knock people unconscious via nerve strikes), Healing (proficient in healing, can cauterize a wound) Enhanced Senses (can see through cloaking devices, can hear things while unconscious, can feel herself being stimulated on a cellular level), Linguistic Assimilation (Can absorb languages via touch, mostly by kissing), Enhanced Beauty (Causes even animals and rock based lifeforms to be attracted to her), Non-Physical Interaction (Affected Raven's Soul-Self and was stated to be able to stop Raven despite her intangibility). Resistance to Acupuncture (human pressure points don't work on her), Fire Manipulation (withstood the burning solar attack of the sun titaness Theia), Ice Manipulation (resisted being frozen), Knockout gases (knockout gases didn't work on Starfire), Memory Manipulation (Starfire's memories are particularly hard to read), Fear Manipulation (was immune to Phobia's fear manipulation), Emotional Manipulation (an apathy fiend didn't effect Starfire), Energy Manipulation and Power Nullification (Energy Dampening and Power Nullification technology doesn't work on her 1 2 3), Death Manipulation (Survived a hit from the Horsemen of Death), Time Manipulation and Reality-Warping (Survived near the closure of the cosmic storm which sent out a reality-warping wave that massively warped time)

Static's body on its own possesses:, Superhuman Physical Characteristics (See Speed, Lifting Strength and Durability), Acrobatics and Superhuman Athleticism (Avoided a robot in the Watchtower in an incredible feat of agility), Stealth Mastery (Snuck away from Harley, Ivy and Nails totally undetected after a brief light flash), Vehicular Mastery with the Static Saucer (Static, as one would expect due to his years of experience with it, is extremely adept at flight using his Static Saucer: his expertise is so great that he can do a flip to avoid a net in mid-air, dodge projectiles in mid-air with minimum movement, et cetera), Social Influencing (Charisma: Talked Permafrost down whilst she was seemingly in the throes of a violent behavioral episode, and convinced her to seek help instead of creating further snowstorms) Static's power (granted by the Big Bang awakening his Meta-Gene) is Electricity Manipulation, which is simply a broad umbrella term - his meta-gene actually grants him several different

Small Building Level to Small Town Level whilst holding back (0.11 Tons to 4.55 Kilotons - Even his ultra-casual beams, released from a single finger, can create a sizable crater. Has grown tremendously over the years, and as such by Season 4 should be able to casually outperform his Season 1 self, who could do this. Melted a huge mass of ice very early in his career. His own blast, reflected back at him, could put him on the ground despite his efforts to block it with his arms. Reduced a storefront to rubble with a single blast. Is a rival to Hotstreak (and has fought/defeated him many times) - Hotstreak's powers have created this explosion, blown up a car, and destroyed a wall whilst weakened by the Bang Baby cure. Knocked out Harley Quinn and The Joker with ease, and oneshotted Batman II. Oneshot Kangor, a bang baby powerful enough to completely destroy a police car by simply landing on it, kick another police car several stories into the air, and stomp a deep fissure into the ground. Overpowered Spectral's laser, which blew up a large part of a ceiling. Comparable to Soul Power (who flattened a building sized robot), and contributed to a blast which knocked out Professor Menace, someone capable of surviving the building he was inside exploding. Hurt Osebo, who destroyed a wall. A practically infinitesimal portion of his power made a Zap Cap powerful enough to destroy most of a car. Knocked Batman out with an electric shock. Starburst, who derived his powers from Static, could create a crater of this magnitude. Totaled a car by throwing a barrel at it. Overpowered and staggered Heavyman, who could stomp a massive fissure into the ground. Harmed Tamara Lawrence, who could total a car with a punch, destroy a bridge by simply flexing, lift a carousel, and uproot a tree. Is a consistent opponent of Onyx, who smashed through a wall. Created a large crater. Can knock out Talon, who can harm him and take blasts from D-Struct: said blasts could obliterate a small building and blast apart the front of a bus. Hurt Tarmac, who could bust through a wall and slam a metal door off its hinges. Staggered and held his own against Tantrum, a bang baby strong enough to destroy a door, lift and throw a car, and lift an entire ferris wheel. Blasted apart a section of some bleachers), Large Planet Level at full power (Downscaling from 1.03 Ronnatons - Temporarily beam struggled with a bloodlusted, mind controlled Green Lantern, and harmed him at a later date - albeit in the latter instance, GL was fatigued and using a ring with almost no charge. Dwayne McDuffie implied that the difference between Static and GL (as in, the reason Static cannot defeat him) is moreso experience rather than raw power. Contributed to recharging the First Watchtower's power core - said core containing enough power to create a barrier that turned aside almost all of the impact from a cosmic superstring, a phenomenon that packs more energy than a solar flare. Amplified GL to the point that he easily overpowered Sinestro, who is his equal in combat under normal circumstances - that, and Static gave GL's ring what seems to be a full charge even before amplifying his power), higher during a Sunspot (As established in S2 E5, Static becomes far more powerful during a sunspot)

Relativistic+ combat speed and reactions (Scaling to 0.53c - Kept up with Sinestro and Green Lantern, reacted to and intercepted a mind-controlled Martian Manhunter, and, after moving behind her, attacked Hawkgirl so quickly that she couldn't even turn around before being struck. Reacted to and blocked a light-based laser from Spectral (a villain who used spectrums of light) at close range after it was fired, moving at 0.29c to do so. Similarly, he could block a blast from Green Lantern after it was fired, and dodge one on another occasion - Lantern Beams overtly move at the Speed of Light. Can consistently react to and block/dodge his own lightning. Dodged several thrown Batarangs. Alongside Hotstreak, blitzed away from small missiles. Reacted to Talon's projectile screech and moved quickly enough to block it with microphones after it was fired), with Massively Hypersonic+ attack speed (His electricity beams streaked into orbit at incredible speed) and at least Subsonic travel speed with the Static Saucer (Dodged Talon's projectile screech. Kept ahead of the Flash - whilst Wally is certainly far faster than Static (and thus this is an outlier for Wally), he was still running quickly enough to run across water, necessitating a speed of about 158 miles per hour. Caught up to a plane, albeit he needed to pull out all the stops to do so. Kept up with a speeding sports car)

At least Small Building Level (At least 0.11 Tons - Took his own casual blast reflected back at him, though it did cause him noticeable pain. Was unhurt (if shook up) by this explosion. Took a sound blast from Boom straight to his body - Boom's sound blasts could blow up a wall, destroy a large jumbotron, and vaporize chairs. Was only winded by a kick from Kangor, who can completely destroy a police car by simply landing on it, kick another police car several stories into the air, and stomp a deep fissure into the ground. Took a blast from D-Struct and was only annoyed - D-Struct's blasts could obliterate a kiosk and blow up the front of a bus. Got up after a bodyslam from Carmen Dillo which cratered brick walls - Carmen could also destroy store displays whilst rampaging inside of said store. Took a hit from Chainlink's arms - Chainlink's arms could destroy a wall and a metal floor, as well as a steel girder. Remained conscious after being hit by a tire thrown by a villain - said villain could easily destroy a wall. Was fine after Rubberband Man made a massive vault door fall on him. Whilst fighting imaginary monsters (made real by the powers of a Bang Baby), took hits from both of them - said monsters could destroy a hot dog cart in one hit and crater a stone pillar. Was fine after being sent through the wall of a large vehicle by a blast), and Large Planet Level with Barriers (Downscaling from 1.03 Ronnatons - Turned aside most of the impact of a blast from a bloodlusted, mind controlled Green Lantern)

Notable Attacks/Techniques: *Accelerated Healing: Barry isn't invulnerable, nor durable enough to sustain damage. However, if he is harmed he will heal at high speeds. Any normal wear and tear damage to his bodies are almost instantly healed. *Flight: Barry can rotate his arms and spin his body like a top to achieve something resembling helicopter flight. *Increased Perceptions: Barry travelling at incredibly high speeds may miss important events as they run by. The Speed Force grants him enhanced senses that allow him to see, hear, smell, touch and/or taste at an increased speed and understand it as it is processed. *Phasing: Barry can vibrate his molecules so quickly that he can achieve intangibility allowing him to phase through objects. * Supercharged Brain Activity: Barry can access superhuman levels in his brain further than processing information. He can test theories, understand difficult equations and run trial and error in his brain at superhuman speeds. Barry can think of an enormous number of outcomes of a situation if he focuses the Speed Force on his brain. * Vortex Creation: Barry can rotate his arms and cause an incredible amount of wind to burst through his focused funnel. Barry uses this ability automatically when he runs, reducing the air currents around his body to low enough levels to no longer inhibit their speed. Creatively, Barry can create tornadoes and gusts with his arms. *Speed Force Drag: Can drag people into the Speed Force and have increased stats and control over his power. Barry can even defy gravity and grab things using the Speed Force lightning-aura. *Time Shift: Barry is connected to time in a similar way like Professor Zoom, but Barry doesn't slow time down, he can move it forward. Feats: * Disarms some soldiers before they’re aware they’ve been disarmed. *Searches Manhattan and finds Madam Xanadu before Frankenstein is aware the Flash has even left. *Runs through everywhere in Manhattan saving civilians from monsters. *Can think at a speed where he can see the future and make the best possible choice for every action. * His instincts and reflexes allow him to react and move the femtosecond he feels even the slightest changes in air pressure. *Flash calls the Watch Tower’s computers slow, despite the fact that they can perform over 100 quadrillion calculations per second. * Can learn how to use Hal Jordan's Power Ring in seconds. *Can speed up all of time and space and take everything a few seconds into the future, choosing who to take with him and who to leave behind, skipping a time paradox in the process. Notable Attacks/Techniques: *Accelerated Healing: Barry isn't invulnerable, nor durable enough to sustain damage. However, if he is harmed he will heal at high speeds. Any normal wear and tear damage to his bodies are almost instantly healed. *Flight: Barry can rotate his arms and spin his body like a top to achieve something resembling helicopter flight. *Increased Perceptions: Barry travelling at incredibly high speeds may miss important events as they run by. The Speed Force grants him enhanced senses that allow him to see, hear, smell, touch and/or taste at an increased speed and understand it as it is processed. *Phasing: Barry can vibrate his molecules so quickly that he can achieve intangibility allowing him to phase through objects. * Supercharged Brain Activity: Barry can access superhuman levels in his brain further than processing information. He can test theories, understand difficult equations and run trial and error in his brain at superhuman speeds. Barry can think of an enormous number of outcomes of a situation if he focuses the Speed Force on his brain. * Vortex Creation: Barry can rotate his arms and cause an incredible amount of wind to burst through his focused funnel. Barry uses this ability automatically when he runs, reducing the air currents around his body to low enough levels to no longer inhibit their speed. Creatively, Barry can create tornadoes and gusts with his arms. *Speed Force Drag: Can drag people into the Speed Force and have increased stats and control over his power. Barry can even defy gravity and grab things using the Speed Force lightning-aura. *Time Shift: Barry is connected to time in a similar way like Professor Zoom, but Barry doesn't slow time down, he can move it forward. Note: Although many people refer to his technique as the Infinite Mass Punch, the name doesn't accurately depict the events that play out. While it is theoretically possible for Flash to attain Infinite Mass, Flash has not shown the qualities of having Infinite Mass in any of the instances he performed. Genius (Superman is extraordinarily intelligent due to being the son of Jor-El, the greatest genetically engineered scientist of the Kryptonian Thinker Guild. Clark's intelligence was implied at an early age, winning a science fair at age 9 and reading "The Republic of Plato" when he was only 13. As an adult, Clark successfully falsified personal information concerning his identity, name and work history, allowing him to stay hidden while traversing the world for many years. Clark has displayed basic medical knowledge, knowing to cauterize one of Lois Lane's wounds after she was injured. As a reporter for the Daily Planet, Clark is exceptionally skilled, receiving the Elliot Prize for Investigative Journalism twice after working for a year, being the first of any reporters on the Daily Planet staff to earn it. His investigative skills, coupled with a convenient instance of his Kryptonian Powers, allowed him to deduce Bruce Wayne's identity. Despite not having any formal combat training, Superman is a quick improvisational learner and effective brawler, as seen when he was pitted against several highly trained Kryptonians, Doomsday, the Justice League and Steppenwolf)

Their biological makeup includes a number of organs that lack analogues in humans and whose functions are unknown. Typically, the power is seen as two beams of red light emanating from the eyes. These beams can be made invisible, allowing the power to be undetectable. The maximum temperature of their heat vision is said to be around that of a nuclear detonation. They can also consciously determine the area affected, down to the microscopic level. *Super-Hearing: Kryptonian hearing is sensitive enough to hear any sound at any volume or pitch. They can see and identify radio and television signals as well as all other broadcast or transmitted frequencies. Using this ability, they can avoid detection by radar or satellite monitoring methods. This also allows them to see the aura generated by living things. **Telescopic Vision: This is the ability to see something at a great distance, without violating the laws of physics. Though limited, the exact extent of the ability is undetermined. In function, it is similar to the zoom lens on a camera. **X-Ray Vision: This is the ability to see through any volume of matter except lead. Kryptonians can see things behind a solid, opaque object as if it were not there. They can focus this ability to "peel back" layers of an object, allowing hidden image or inner workings to be observed. This ability perceives an ambient energy source though, it does not involve the eye projecting a concentrated, possibly toxic, beam to be reflected back from objects. **Microscopic Vision: This is the ability to see extremely small objects and images down to the atomic level. **Infrared Vision: Kryptonians can see with better acuity in darkness, and to a degree in total darkness. *Red Energy Conduit: The rings use Red energy, supplied by a Power Battery, which in most cases takes the form of red light. The ring can also create fields of force formed from an unknown energy that was bound by the users' will. It can be surmised that is the effect of the internal rage on the blood. These flames burn even in space. The effect it has on living beings allows it to ignite the flames of rage in a victims' blood and has the effect of burning through an energy aura of an opponent as well as corrupting other power rings depleting them at an accelerated rate and greatly weakening the structures they create. This power is so strong that it can destroy members of the Black Lantern Corps by obliterating them faster than they can regenerate. **Energy Projection: The ring can be used to fire blasts of Rage energy. This power is unique as it takes the form of rage-energized blood. The ring can project this blood as a blast that has the effect of a concussive blast with high destructive capability. Throughout his three years of experience as a superhero, has been shown to be a highly skilled fighter normally, and while weakened was able to outskill many Raptor platoons at once, and uses his environments and abilities in creative ways to defeat opponents and save lives on a regular basis) Standard Tactics: Superman fights so precisely that he can strike only his target while making sure everyone nearby stays safe. He first scans the entire area with X-ray, infrared and microscopic vision to locate hostiles and weak points in the terrain, then removes by standers before engaging the opponent. Once the field is clear, he tries a non-lethal disable, heat-vision spot blasts to critical tech, super breath to pin limbs or redirecting the foe into open sky or empty area. If brute force becomes unavoidable, he weaponises the environment swinging structures such as water towers to pressure opponents and uses sheer speed and quick fake outs to end the fight with one decisive blow. Throughout, he constantly meters his strength to avoid lethal collateral damage and when injured, seeks direct sunlight mid battle to jump start his regeneration, buying seconds of recovery before re-engaging.

Kryptonite and Red Sun radiation leaves him in a weakened, depowered state. His X-Ray vision cannot see through lead. Notable Attacks/Techniques: *Heat Vision: Superman focuses stored solar energy through his optic nerves to fire beams of intense heat that can melt steel or knock back opponents. He does not possess superhuman strength levels despite his enhanced cellular ability without his cellular structure charged with yellow solar energy. Without such charging, his physical capabilities are identical to a human of his height and weight who engages in regular physical activity. As an alien, he possesses several organs whose functions are not yet disclosed or understood, but are believed to be part of or the source of his bio-matrix force field and reclamation aura. Superman's body also stores energy actively within his bio-cellular matrix as an energy pattern that is linked to his body's electromagnetic field. This energy powers most of his abilities such as flight, heat vision and other solar-based abilities while supplementing his physical abilities to superhuman levels. ** Stellar Radiation Absorption: As a Kryptonian, his cells function like a super battery, hyper metabolizing specific wavelengths of radiation as fuel to enable living functions and/or superhuman abilities. Different wavelengths of radiation have different effects on Superman's physiology and well being, but his cells cannot absorb or utilize all types of radiation. The wavelength of his home star system's red sun enables his body to function on an identical level of a healthy human while the solar radiation on Earth, in both its raw and filtered state through the Earth's atmosphere, acts as fuel to enable all of his powers. Every time Superman uses any of his superhuman abilities, his body expends absorbed sunlight and he is capable utilizing any of them to various degrees through controlled circumstances. The stellar radiation of a foreign blue star proved to increase his known abilities under a yellow sun to a higher degree and enabled additional powers. ** Superhuman Strength: Superman has the ability to physically lift massive levels of weight, and deliver blows which have the force of trillions of gigatons of TNT explosives. ** Superhuman
