He is susceptible to red sunlight (though the Anti-Monitor armor negates this weakness). He has an innate fear of the Flashes due to being sealed in the Speed Force for a significant amount of time. Superboy-Prime is dangerously psychotic and insane, and will act irrationally at the slightest provocation. Feats: * Killed 30 Green Lanterns * Tanked punches from Bart Allen after the latter absorbed the entirety of the speed force. * Punched through the body of a weakened Anti-Monitor and tossing the rest of his body into space * Defeated people such as Ion (Sodam Yat), Black Adam, Wonder Woman, Martian Manhunter, Power Girl, Superman, and his counterparts in Infinite Crisis. * During the Sinestro Corps War, it took a Guardian of the Universe to defeat him, sacrificing himself by releasing all the energy contained in his body. All the Oan energy released by the Guardian ended up being absorbed by Superman-Prime making him even more powerful. With that power, he tortured Mr. Mxyzptlk and survived an explosion powerful enough to destroy the universe during his fight with Monarch, a cosmic being who fought and defeated numerous counterparts of Captain Atom simultaneously and Superman and attempted to conquer the Multiverse in Countdown to Final Crisis. * After losing the Oan energy and being transported to the 30th Century, he proceeded to tank an attack from Mordru and take on the Legion of Super-Heroes with ease. Notes: *Superboy-Prime originally appeared during the Crisis on Infinite Earths and was portrayed as roughly on par with Superman and other Pre-Crisis Kryptonians, but since he was taken to a pocket dimension outside of the conventional multiverse after battling the Anti-Monitor, his feats, power, and continuity were not rebooted like most other Pre-Crisis characters. *Do not scale Superboy-Prime from his fight with The Darkest Knight. He had no official reason for such a ridiculously extreme power-up, has no feats of his own anywhere near approaching this scale, and needed help to even accomplish a planetary feat right previously in the Death Metal storyline.Dark Nights: Death Metal Vol 1 5 There was no logical reason for him to suddenly gain so much power other than extreme plot convention. Solar System level (Is The Green's Ultimate Avatar, destined to fight against The Rot, a force so powerful that in an alternate future they defeated and zombified almost every single Metahuman on Earth. Easily defeated the Machine Parliament's Avatar. Overpowered Superman and fought Wonder Woman. Sliced Rotling Starro in half. Far above Aquaman, Etrigan and Zatanna)
At least FTL Movement Speed (Has fought Wonder Woman, Superman and Aquaman. Reacted to Rotling Kid Flash)
Varies. Solar System level at its strongest (Has survived blows from a bloodlusted Wonder Woman, Aquaman, and Superman without having to regenerate)
Superhuman
Planetary. Multiversal+ through The Green
None notable
Vastly Superhuman

Name: The Swamp Thing, Allec Holland Origin: DC Comics Gender: Male, female or genderless Age: In his 30s - 40s Classification: Former Human, Plant Elemental, Avatar of The Green
2-C, likely far higher | 1-A, likely High 1-A with The World Tree

Superhuman Physical Characteristics, Immortality (Types 1, 3, 8), Regeneration (High-Godly, Capable of Regenerating even if his existence is destroyed as long as The Green exists, and regenerating even if his connection to The Green is completely cut-off, or if he is destroyed alongside The Green itself), Reality Warping, Self-Sustenance (Types 1, 2 & 3), Causality Manipulation (Fixed Post-Crisis Supermans' flawed connection with the Post-Flashpoint Reality, which was causing a disturbance in The Green), Plant Manipulation (Holds absolute control over every kind of Plant Life on the entire universe), Elemental Manipulation (Earth Manipulation, Water Manipulation, Air Manipulation), Shapeshifting/Sizeshifting (Can assume any form he desires, even growing as large as an entire landmass, or shrinking to a quantic level), Weather Manipulation, Soul Manipulation, Flight, Teleportation (Through Degenerating and then Regenerating himself on another location), Duplication/Creation (Can create many clones of himself and inhabit multiple bodies at once), Cosmic Awareness (Through The Green), Summoning, Poison Manipulation

Low Multiverse level, likely far higher (Fought against Wonder Woman. Has fought against Superman and harmed him. Far above than Zatanna, Aquaman and Etrigan. Defeated Anton Arcane in close combat, who was stated to be comparable in power to Trigon as well as to The Spectre) | Outerverse level, likely High Outerverse level with The World Tree (The World Tree is the root of all creation, including all higher dimensions, and is the foundation of all Magic and Miracles. With it Swamp Thing completely obliterated Pralaya and restored all creation into existence. Pralaya is the embodiment of the void, unconscious mind of God, she was here before Creation and everything emerged from her body. All of Creation emerged from her body, and when it’s time creation will come back to her. She's beyond time and space and could literally destroy all of creation. Creation cannot exist without Pralaya, even God will return to her at some point. She's destroyed all of Creation except for The House of Mysteries. She destroyed everything, including the Sphere of Gods, the Bleed, Orerry of Worlds, etc.)
Immeasurable (Has fought against Wonder Woman and react to her. Fought with Superman) | Irrelevant

Low Multiverse level, likely far higher (Has tanked hits from Wonder Woman, Superman and Aquaman without a having to regenerate) Regeneration makes him extremely hard to kill. | Outerverse level, likely High Outerverse level
Rarely uses his full power
, possibly

Superhuman Physical Characteristics, Self-Sustenance (Types 1 & 3), Incorporeality (His consciousness can exist without his body. His mind is a function of his astral body, and isn't linked to his brain), Nigh-Omnipresence (Had become the world. His soul is one with the entirety of The Green), Immortality (Types 1, 2, 3, 6 & 8. Reliant to The Green as well as his connection to it), Can reconnect to The Green after having his connection with it cut off, Reality Warping, Regeneration (High-Mid. Could regenerate his full body from plant life after he had his body completely destroyed and the Multiverse he inhabited collapsed, through his essence surviving, going into another universe and regrowing a new body from the plants he possessed with said essence), Possession (Can possess singular seeds and grow new bodies through them anywhere on the world, in other planets light-years away, in other points in time, and even if the Multiverse collapses. Can also take control over someone else's body and possessed Constantine), Extrasensory Perception (Is aware of what goes on around him through the Green. Can sense all plants on the globe. Can sense alteration on the Green down to a sub-molecular level. Can sense all life on the planet at once and see through their eyes. Can easily locate anyone on the planet. Can sense when beings enter Earth from other planets), Body Control & Bodily Weaponry (Can manipulate his body in many ways such as growing a third hand from another place, grow spikes or generete a blade in his arm), Body Puppetry (Took control of Constantine to make him walk after he passed out), Flight (Can create his own wings to fly. Can naturally fly as his soul/mind or when using certain elements as his body), Plant Manipulation (Holds practically absolute control over all plant life across the Universe and also holds some control over Fungus), Sleep Manipulation (Used acids to make Pre-Crisis Superman fall asleep), Matter Manipulation (To the point of manipulating the vibration of Quantum-Strings), Shapeshifting/Sizeshifting (Can alter his form into practically anything he desires including growing as large as an entire landmass, or shrinking to a quantum level, or existing solely as electromagnetic frequencies), Elemental Manipulation (Fire, Earth, Water, Air, Magma, Electricity and Ice Manipulation. Has complete control over Fire, Earth, Water and Air, the elements that make up Creation. Can reshape mountains, possess an area of land, cause earthquakes, give life to stones and gain control over Earth as a whole. Can access The Melt and The Blue, which connect all magma and water in the same way The Green connects all plant life. Has control over all water on Earth. Can communicate through fire. Can summon lightning and create electricity from his hands. Can freeze blood inside a person), Weather Manipulation (Can create thunderstorms), Intangibility (Elemental, albeit never used to phase through stuff. Can make bodies out of elements such as water or clouds), Life Manipulation (Gave life to a stone), Transmutation (Manipulated the flora in someone's gut to turn him into a tree), Creation (Created a body which looked like his wife, a new body for Anton Arcane and an entire town filled with people), Biological Manipulation (Made a human target explode without having to touch it. Can alter the chemical balance in someone's brain), Acid Manipulation (Dissolved a rock monster with acid), Sound Manipulation (Can build air conditioning and make music with his plants), Planetary Telepathy (Can read mind by touching the Green as well as accessing someone's memories. Can communicate with others telepathically. Read the memories of a dead child. Can read the memories of a book as its pages were once a tree), Empathy Manipulation, Mind Manipulation (Can use his plants to make others act primordially. Invaded Aquaman's mind. Influenced Killer Croc into going to his swamp), Memory Manipulation (Can place memories into fruits so whoever eats them will be able to recall these memories), Perception Manipulation (Can release a chemical which makes the opponent have hallucination. Can create plants that allow those who eat them to see the world as he does), Blood Manipulation & Death Manipulation (Can manipulate the human bloodstream, can freeze blood inside a person, dry out their cranial fluid, burst a person’s heart or instantly dehydrate them), Vibration Manipulation (Can control vibrations), Teleportation/BFR (Can teleport others through the Green), Time Travel (Accidentally time travelled to WWII & 1872. His astral form can travel through the timestream. Talked about his potential to time travel along with other things), Dimensional Travel (His essence can jump into another universe and create a new body for him there), Astral Projection (Can enter the afterlife), Soul Manipulation/Stealing, Magic, Duplication (Capable of creating multiple bodies for himself, and controlling all of them at once), Healing/Resurrecti

Low Complex Multiverse level (Described as being one with the world / universe multiple times. Fought and defeated Anton Arcane when, according to the Monitor, he had become as powerful as Trigon and Jim Corrigan. Holds control over the forces that make up Creation) | Outerverse level (Exists as a Conceptual Being beyond all creation and all Metaphysical Parliaments), possibly High Outerverse level (The Word, the Spectre's older and stronger brother, didn't confront Swamp Thing until the latter's powers were removed. Potentially equal to the Voice itself. They were planning to take over the old place of God with their order and rewrite the whole of Creation. Absorbed all of the Parliaments, exists as the full embodiment of the Green, a conceptual power equivalent to the Red, a completely nonphysical and transcendental "implicate order" of ideas and imagination from which the "explicate order" of physical reality merely unfolds from. The Red's highest world transcends the limits of the human mind and cannot be charted by three-dimensional maps as it exists outside of space and time)
Speed of Light combat speed, Massively FTL+ travel speed (Flew across the galaxy) | Omnipresent

Unknown (Usually capable of being damaged by low-level weapons and attacks), regeneration, immortalities and possession makes him very hard to kill, which was demonstrated when he took an attack from The Anti-Monitor, got his body completely destroyed and survived by merging his essence with The Green, and creating a new body somewhere else) | Outerverse level, possibly High Outerverse level
Infinite | Infinite
At least Planetary | Outerversal, possibly High Outerversal
None notable *Optional
Extraordinary Genius | Nigh-Omniscient

As Monarch, he likes to emotionally hurt his opponents and hold the higher ground intellectually before unleashing his power against them. *Energy over matter: Captain Atom's primary method of attack is energy manipulation. His power is such, that he went even further, and by simply thinking of it, he was able to instantaneously create an entire universe out of nothing, and just as easily destroyed an entire universe, but he has never used this level of power again as a result of him mentally limiting himself. Captain Atom is also able to absorb potentially harmful energy into himself, but absorbing too much can overload him and send him hurtling through time. Captain Atom can fire and control energy of any form. He commonly manipulates his energy into forcefield bubbles, or explosive 'bombs', as well as simple blasts of kinetic force. While he usually aims with his hands, he is able to emit energy from any point on his body. Several times he has "detonated", releasing a massive amount of energy at once, destroying objects within an certain radius. On more than one occasion, he has used his ability to manipulate all forms of energy to prevent a foe using their own powers, such as the Ray and Firestorm.

Hypersonic (Scaling to Mach 8.7), possibly Relativistic+ (Scaling to 0.53c) reactions and combat speed (Tagged Killer Croc several times in their fight), and Subsonic or higher attack speed with Firearms

Cannot make major decisions without flipping his coin, and will lose his composure if he cannot consult it. Ergo, I only consider those three comics canon. Category:Goulden1998 Category:Tier 9

field_candidates.value: These are powers or abilities that are commonly displayed amongst members of the Green Lantern Corps in order for them to combat their enemies effectively, though do keep in mind not every member shares the same hax these are just the ones that are inherent byproducts of being a member of the Green Lantern Corps...Willpower Manipulation, Emotional Manipulation, Energy Manipulation via Emotional Energy Manipulation (Members of the Green Lantern Corps harness the power of willpower from the Emotional Energy Spectrum in order to fuel their ringsGreen Lantern: Rebirth #3 (February, 2005), it's also stated hereGreen Lantern Vol 5 #21 (August, 2013)), Indomitable Will, Flight, Creation (By using their imaginations members of the Green Lantern Corps can create constructs using their rings, Two-Six states this to be an akin to an equation with an infinite amount of possible outcomes), Telepathy (Members of The Green Lantern Corps can communicate with other members via telepathic sub-channels),

*Cannot harm anything that is yellow. *Rings only hold a limited energy and must be recharged with a power source on a regular basis. *If the user is filled with dread, they will be unable to use the ring and become vulnerable to the hue yellow. *If Green Lantern loses focus or concentration (for example, due to illusions), his strength weakens. (Basically don't edit my page without my consent) ==Explanations & Related Blog Posts== *Emotional Energy Spectrum: Green occupies the central position in the spectrum and symbolizes the emotion of willpower. It holds the distinction of exerting the least influence on its wielder and can only be mastered by individuals with an indomitable will capable of overcoming great fear. The embodiment of this emotion is Ion. The Maltusians initially harnessed this energy, which later passed on to the Oans, male Maltusians who aspired to establish order in the universe. After the Controllers departed, those remaining on Oa evolved into the Guardians of the Universe. They utilized the green light as the power source for the Green Lantern Corps, an organization committed to combating evil wherever and whenever it emerged to threaten the universe. ==Gallery== *310 Appearances of Green Lantern Corps (Prime Earth) *75 Images that include Green Lantern Corps (Prime Earth) *Organization Gallery: Green Lantern Corps (Prime Earth) ==Others== Notable Victories: Notable Losses: Inconclusive Matches: ==References== ==Categories

field_candidates.value: These are powers or abilities that are commonly displayed amongst members of the Green Lantern Corps in order for them to combat their enemies effectively, though do keep in mind not every member shares the same hax these are just the ones that are inherent byproducts of being a member of the Green Lantern Corps...Willpower Manipulation, Emotional Manipulation, Energy Manipulation via Emotional Energy Manipulation (Members of the Green Lantern Corps harness the power of willpower from the Emotional Energy Spectrum in order to fuel their ringsGreen Lantern: Rebirth #3 (February, 2005), it's also stated hereGreen Lantern Vol 5 #21 (August, 2013)), Indomitable Will, Flight, Creation (By using their imaginations members of the Green Lantern Corps can create constructs using their rings, Two-Six states this to be an akin to an equation with an infinite amount of possible outcomes), Telepathy (Members of The Green Lantern Corps can communicate with other members via telepathic sub-channels)

Cannot harm anything that is yellow., Rings only hold a limited energy and must be recharged with a power source on a regular basis., If the user is filled with dread, they will be unable to use the ring and become vulnerable to the hue yellow., If Green Lantern loses focus or concentration (for example, due to illusions), his strength weakens, or revisions are strictly prohibited. Unauthorized editing may compromise the accuracy, and reliability of the content. If you have suggestions or concerns regarding the information presented herein, Emotional Energy Spectrum: Green occupies the central position in the spectrum and symbolizes the emotion of willpower. It holds the distinction of exerting the least influence on its wielder and can only be mastered by individuals with an indomitable will capable of overcoming great fear. The embodiment of this emotion is Ion. The Maltusians initially harnessed this energy, which later passed on to the Oans, male Maltusians who aspired to establish order in the universe. After the Controllers departed, those remaining on Oa evolved into the Guardians of the Universe. They utilized the green light as the power source for the Green Lantern Corps, 310 Appearances of Green Lantern Corps (Prime Earth), 75 Images that include Green Lantern Corps (Prime Earth)

Tier: 9-A physically, Low 7-C via Weapons Name: Adrian Chase Nicknames: Vigilante (Hero), DCEU Vigilante (Out of Universe) Origin: DC Extended Universe later incorporated into the DC Multiverse Gender/Sex: Male (He/Him/His) Kill Count: At Least 10 Age: 29 (August to October 2020; Born June 1991) Height: 180.3 cm Weight: 78 kg Classification: Human, Mass Serial Murderer, Anti-Hero, Superhuman Physical Characteristics, Martial Arts (Beat down a thug with little to no effort. Chase is a highly skilled and formidable hand-to-hand combatant and martial artist. He is able to fight the master martial artist, Judomaster alongside Peacemaker, even managing to outlast Peacemaker before he was defeated by the more skilled foe.), Pressure Point Strikes, Acrobatics and Agility, Weapon & Armour Mastery, Stealth Mastery (Tracked down and followed Task Force X without being noticed.), Preparation (Always equipped with weapons and his suit. Found Task Force X with no info.), Natural Weaponry (Fist, Feet, Teeth, and Nails), Social Influence, Reputation, Fear Inducing, & Respect, Known as a hero. Likely gained respect or fear from other prisoners after beating one up., Vehicular Mastery Attack Potency: Small Building Level physically (Comparable but inferior to Peacemaker. Can fight White Dragon, who charged a blast to destroy part of a van (40.423 MJ), White Dragon could have killed him (0.022-0.0838 Tons). Can fight possessed humans who survive shockwaves ([https://vsbattles.fandom.com/wiki/User_blog:Spinosaurus75DinosaurFan/Peacemaker_Sonic_Boom 13,957.2 J]) no problem ([https://character-stats-and-profiles.fandom.com/wiki/User_blog:XxAngel_EditzxX/Feat_Scaling#To_tank_something 35.65-136.75 KJ]). Possibly comparable to his CW counterpart who can fight Green Arrow.), Small Town Level via Weapons (Owns an assortment of guns. Has access to a chainsaw. His guns should be comparable to Peacemakers and Harley's Javelin which was used to kill Starro (2.467 Kilotons).) Destructive Capacity: Street Level (Can fight regular people.) Physical Strength: Small Building Level Striking Strength: Small Building Level (Knocked a man down in a few hits.) Travel Speed: Peak Human to Peak Human+ (Can keep up with Peacemaker who is faster than most people and likely comparable to a gorilla ([https://a-z-animals.com/animals/western-gorilla/ 11.176 m/s]).) Combat/Reaction/Perception Speed: Peak Human+ (Can attack faster than most can react, comparable to Peacemaker and Judomaster), Superhuman via Chainsaw (Min 16 m/s), Subsonic to Supersonic via Weapons (100 to 740 m/s). Hypersonic+ via Grenade Explosion ([https://vsbattles.fandom.com/wiki/MK2_Grenade 6900 m/s]) Lifting Strength: Class 10+ (Can hold his weight. Can restrain people down, can push back White Dragon who ripped a roof of a van off ([https://character-stats-and-profiles.fandom.com/wiki/User_blog:XxAngel_EditzxX/Show_Feats_Scaling#Racist_hates_white_van_(S1_E7) 7702.14 kg]). Could be comparable to Peacemaker, who wrestled a gorilla who can rip off limbs ([https://character-stats-and-profiles.fandom.com/wiki/User_blog:XxAngel_EditzxX/Feat_Scaling#Cutting_an_Arm/Leg 1019.72 to 8667.59 kgf]).) Durability: Small Building Level (Can survive attacks from White Dragon who was trying to kill him. Survived a dangerous van crashing which is higher than this (Likely [https://vsbattles.fandom.com/wiki/References_for_Common_Feats#Destroying_a_Car 50 MJ]). Survived getting a toe cut off.) Stamina: Peak Human [https://fictional-indexing.fandom.com/wiki/Endurance Endurance]: Superhuman (Right after a van crash he went to attack and wasn't tired at the end. Can fight multiple thugs at the same time. Can walk around with a toe gut off.) Range: Standard Melee Range to Standard Melee Range+ (Arm is 38.65% of height; 69.7 cm. Leg is 52.15% of height; 94.03 cm), Extended Melee Range via Chainsaw, Suit, Knife, Sword, Walther P99, FN P90, Optional Equipment: Chainsaw, Colt Single Action Army, Mossberg 500 Cruiser, MasterPiece Arms MPA30DMG, Walther PPQ Q5 Match, Dynamite, Grenade Intelligence: Gifted (Is a skilled fighter in both armed and unarmed combat. Killed three targets in quick succession with a sniper rifle. Purposefully got himself arrested to kill Auggie Smith inside the prison and goaded his followers to strike first, so it would look like self-defence to passive onlookers, going on to stomp said followers in hand-to-hand combat. Deduced the weakspots in White Dragon's armor upon seeing it the first time. Avoided detection from a black-ops group.) Weaknesses: Standard Human Limits, Emotions, & Eyesight.
